info.name: Adobe Creative Suite Adobe Firefly Accessibility Search API
Adobe Creative Suite Search Stock Files

params.name: locale
params.description: BCP 47 locale code for localized search results

params.name: search_parameters[words]
params.description: Keywords to search for in the stock library

params.name: search_parameters[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (1-64)

params.name: search_parameters[offset]
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: search_parameters[filters][content_type:photo]
params.description: Include photos in results (1 = include, 0 = exclude)

params.name: search_parameters[filters][content_type:illustration]
params.description: Include illustrations in results (1 = include, 0 = exclude)

params.name: search_parameters[filters][content_type:vector]
params.description: Include vector files in results (1 = include, 0 = exclude)

params.name: search_parameters[filters][content_type:video]
params.description: Include video files in results (1 = include, 0 = exclude)

params.name: result_columns[]
params.description: Fields to include in the response for each result

items.docs: Searches the Adobe Stock library for files matching specified criteria such as keywords, content type, orientation, and color. Returns a paginated list of matching stock files with metadata including thumbnails, dimensions, and licensing status. Requires an API key header in addition to authentication.

info.name: Adobe Creative Suite Get Stock File Metadata

params.name: locale
params.description: BCP 47 locale for localized response data

params.name: result_columns[]
params.description: Fields to include in the response

items.docs: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific stock file by its content ID. Returns full file information including title, creator, dimensions, keywords, licensing status, and thumbnail URLs.

info.name: Adobe Creative Suite Get Category Tree

params.name: locale
params.description: BCP 47 locale for localized category names

params.name: category_id
params.description: Root category ID to retrieve subtree from (omit for full tree)

items.docs: Retrieves the hierarchical category tree used to organize Adobe Stock content. Categories can be used as filters in search queries to narrow results to specific content categories such as Animals, Business, or Technology.
